condition: coalescing firm fibrotic papules on the posterior neck over 8 months of close clipper haircuts in a Black man
level_rationale: An 8-month history of firm scarred papules joining together on the back of the neck associated with close clipper haircuts in a 27-year-old Black man indicates scarring folliculitis keloidalis of the posterior neck requiring dermatologist evaluation for potent topical or intralesional corticosteroid therapy to halt keloidal plaque progression, whereas getting 2 tiny superficial pimples on the back of the neck after close clipper haircuts reflects benign transient follicular irritation manageable with routine self-care.
